fr.title: L'ouverture de la fenêtre des introductions en bourse : ce que signifie une vague de méga-cotations pour les investisseurs et les fonds indiciels

segments.src: When large private companies talk about going public, markets pay attention.
segments.tr: Lorsque de grandes entreprises privées envisagent une entrée en bourse, les marchés y prêtent attention.

segments.src: Recent reports that several high-profile artificial intelligence companies are preparing or considering stock market debuts have revived an old Wall Street question: if a flood of new shares arrives, does money leave existing stocks to make room for it?
segments.tr: Des informations récentes selon lesquelles plusieurs entreprises d'intelligence artificielle très en vue se préparent ou envisagent de faire leurs débuts en bourse ont ravivé une vieille question de Wall Street : si un afflux de nouvelles actions arrive, l'argent quitte-t-il les actions existantes pour leur faire de la place ?

segments.src: This article explains how an initial public offering (IPO) works, what the filings tell you, and why even people who only own index funds may end up with exposure.
segments.tr: Cet article explique comment fonctionne une introduction en bourse (IPO), ce que révèlent les documents déposés et pourquoi même les personnes qui ne détiennent que des fonds indiciels peuvent finir par y être exposées.

segments.src: It is general education, not investment advice, and the reports it discusses may change.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'une information générale, et non d'un conseil en investissement, et les informations évoquées ici sont susceptibles de changer.

segments.src: ## What an IPO Actually Is
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'est réellement une introduction en bourse

segments.src: An initial public offering is the first time a company sells its shares to the general public on a stock exchange.
segments.tr: Une introduction en bourse est la première fois qu'une entreprise vend ses actions au grand public sur une bourse de valeurs.

segments.src: Before that, the company is "private," and its owners are typically founders, employees, venture capital firms and other institutional backers.
segments.tr: Auparavant, l'entreprise est « privée », et ses propriétaires sont généralement les fondateurs, les salariés, les sociétés de capital-risque et d'autres investisseurs institutionnels.

segments.src: The basic steps look like this:
segments.tr: Les étapes de base se présentent ainsi :

segments.src: 1. **Preparation.** The company hires investment banks, called underwriters, and works with lawyers and auditors to assemble financial disclosures.
segments.tr: 1. **Préparation.** L'entreprise fait appel à des banques d'investissement, appelées teneurs de livre (underwriters), et travaille avec des avocats et des auditeurs pour rassembler les informations financières à publier.

segments.src: 2. **Filing.** The company submits a registration statement to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Companies can sometimes file confidentially at first, then make the document public before marketing the shares.
segments.tr: 2. **Dépôt.** L'entreprise soumet une déclaration d'enregistrement à la Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) américaine. Les entreprises peuvent parfois déposer leur dossier de manière confidentielle au départ, puis rendre le document public avant de commercialiser les actions.

segments.src: 3. **Roadshow.** Executives present to large institutional investors to gauge demand. This process is often called book-building.
segments.tr: 3. **Roadshow.** Les dirigeants présentent l'entreprise à de grands investisseurs institutionnels pour évaluer la demande. Ce processus est souvent appelé constitution du carnet d'ordres (book-building).

segments.src: 4. **Pricing.** The underwriters and the company set an offer price the night before trading begins, based on demand.
segments.tr: 4. **Fixation du prix.** Les teneurs de livre et l'entreprise fixent un prix d'offre la veille du début des négociations, en fonction de la demande.

segments.src: 5. **First trade.** Shares begin trading on an exchange. The first-day price can differ sharply from the offer price.
segments.tr: 5. **Première transaction.** Les actions commencent à se négocier sur une bourse. Le cours du premier jour peut différer fortement du prix d'offre.

segments.src: Some of the shares sold are "primary" shares, newly issued by the company to raise money.
segments.tr: Une partie des actions vendues sont des actions « primaires », nouvellement émises par l'entreprise pour lever des fonds.

segments.src: Others are "secondary" shares, sold by existing holders who want to cash out.
segments.tr: D'autres sont des actions « secondaires », vendues par les détenteurs existants qui souhaitent encaisser leurs gains.

segments.src: The mix matters, because only primary shares put new capital in the company's hands.
segments.tr: La répartition compte, car seules les actions primaires apportent de nouveaux capitaux à l'entreprise.

segments.src: ## What the Filings Reveal
segments.tr: ## Ce que révèlent les documents déposés

segments.src: The main public document is the prospectus, often known by its form name, the S-1.
segments.tr: Le principal document public est le prospectus, souvent connu sous le nom de son formulaire, le S-1.

segments.src: Readers who want to look past the headlines can focus on a few sections:
segments.tr: Les lecteurs qui veulent aller au-delà des titres peuvent se concentrer sur quelques sections :

segments.src: - **Financial statements.** Revenue growth, profit or loss, cash burn and debt show whether the business can fund itself.
segments.tr: - **États financiers.** La croissance du chiffre d'affaires, le bénéfice ou la perte, la consommation de trésorerie et la dette indiquent si l'entreprise peut financer son activité par elle-même.

segments.src: - **Risk factors.** Companies must describe material risks, including competition, regulation, customer concentration and dependence on key suppliers.
segments.tr: - **Facteurs de risque.** Les entreprises doivent décrire les risques importants, notamment la concurrence, la réglementation, la concentration de la clientèle et la dépendance à l'égard de fournisseurs clés.

segments.src: - **Use of proceeds.** This explains whether the money will fund growth, repay debt or simply pass to selling shareholders.
segments.tr: - **Utilisation des fonds.** Cette section explique si l'argent servira à financer la croissance, à rembourser une dette ou simplement à être versé aux actionnaires vendeurs.

segments.src: - **Capital structure.** Some companies issue multiple share classes, where founders hold extra voting power. That affects how much say ordinary shareholders have.
segments.tr: - **Structure du capital.** Certaines entreprises émettent plusieurs catégories d'actions, les fondateurs détenant des droits de vote supplémentaires. Cela influe sur le poids des actionnaires ordinaires dans les décisions.

segments.src: - **Lock-up agreements.** Insiders often agree not to sell for a set period, commonly around 180 days. When it ends, a large number of shares can become tradable at once, which can affect the price.
segments.tr: - **Accords de blocage (lock-up).** Les initiés acceptent souvent de ne pas vendre pendant une période déterminée, généralement d'environ 180 jours. À l'expiration de cette période, un grand nombre d'actions peuvent devenir négociables en même temps, ce qui peut peser sur le cours.

segments.src: - **Valuation context.** The price range implies a total company value. Comparing it with revenue and earnings, and with similar listed companies, helps show how much growth is already expected.
segments.tr: - **Contexte de valorisation.** La fourchette de prix implique une valeur totale pour l'entreprise. La comparer au chiffre d'affaires et aux bénéfices, ainsi qu'à celle d'entreprises cotées similaires, permet de voir la croissance déjà anticipée.

segments.src: ## Does a Flood of New Shares Pull Money From Other Stocks?
segments.tr: ## Un afflux de nouvelles actions détourne-t-il l'argent des autres valeurs ?

segments.src: The worry is a supply-and-demand one.
segments.tr: L'inquiétude est d'ordre offre et demande.

segments.src: If investors must buy billions of dollars of new shares, some may sell other holdings to pay for them.
segments.tr: Si les investisseurs doivent acheter des milliards de dollars d'actions nouvelles, certains pourraient vendre d'autres positions pour les financer.

segments.src: In that case, a very large listing could weigh on existing stocks, particularly the ones most similar to the newcomer.
segments.tr: Dans ce cas, une cotation très importante pourrait peser sur les actions existantes, en particulier celles qui ressemblent le plus au nouveau venu.

segments.src: The reality is less clear-cut:
segments.tr: La réalité est moins tranchée :

segments.src: - **Markets are very large.** U.S. stocks trade in the tens of billions of dollars every day, and total market value is measured in the tens of trillions. Even a very large offering is a small slice of that.
segments.tr: - **Les marchés sont très vastes.** Les actions américaines se négocient pour des dizaines de milliards de dollars chaque jour, et la valeur totale du marché se mesure en dizaines de milliers de milliards. Même une offre très importante ne représente qu'une petite part de ce total.

segments.src: - **Funding sources vary.** Money for an IPO can come from cash on the sidelines, new fund inflows or the proceeds of earlier sales, not only from selling other stocks.
segments.tr: - **Les sources de financement varient.** L'argent destiné à une introduction en bourse peut provenir de liquidités en attente, de nouveaux flux vers les fonds ou du produit de ventes antérieures, et pas seulement de la vente d'autres actions.

segments.src: - **Sector effects are more plausible.** If the new company is in a crowded theme, such as AI, investors who want to own it may trim similar names. That effect is usually narrower than a market-wide drop.
segments.tr: - **Les effets sectoriels sont plus plausibles.** Si la nouvelle entreprise évolue dans un thème très convoité, comme l'IA, les investisseurs qui veulent la détenir pourraient alléger leurs positions sur des valeurs similaires. Cet effet est généralement plus limité qu'une baisse générale du marché.

segments.src: - **Sentiment matters.** A strong debut can lift enthusiasm for the whole sector. A weak one can chill it. History includes examples of both.
segments.tr: - **Le sentiment compte.** Des débuts réussis peuvent stimuler l'enthousiasme pour l'ensemble du secteur. Des débuts décevants peuvent le refroidir. L'histoire compte des exemples dans les deux sens.

segments.src: In short, a big IPO can shift money around within a market.
segments.tr: En bref, une grande introduction en bourse peut déplacer des capitaux au sein d'un marché.

segments.src: Whether it drains the market as a whole is much less certain, and it is hard to predict.
segments.tr: Savoir si elle draine l'ensemble du marché est beaucoup plus incertain, et difficile à prévoir.

segments.src: ## Why Index-Fund Holders May Still Be Exposed
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les détenteurs de fonds indiciels peuvent malgré tout être exposés

segments.src: Many people assume that owning a broad index fund means they have no stake in IPOs.
segments.tr: Beaucoup pensent que détenir un fonds indiciel large signifie ne pas avoir d'intérêt dans les introductions en bourse.

segments.src: That is only partly true.
segments.tr: C'est vrai en partie seulement.

segments.src: - **Index inclusion rules differ.** Some major indexes require a new company to trade for a set period, or to meet profitability and size tests, before it can join. Others add new listings more quickly. Rules vary by index provider, so check the methodology for the specific index your fund tracks.
segments.tr: - **Les règles d'intégration aux indices diffèrent.** Certains grands indices exigent qu'une nouvelle entreprise soit cotée pendant une période déterminée, ou satisfasse à des critères de rentabilité et de taille, avant d'y entrer. D'autres ajoutent les nouvelles cotations plus rapidement. Les règles varient selon le fournisseur d'indices : vérifiez la méthodologie de l'indice suivi par votre fonds.

segments.src: - **Total-market funds add new listings.** Funds that follow broad "total market" indexes tend to take in newly listed large companies relatively soon after they list.
segments.tr: - **Les fonds « marché total » intègrent les nouvelles cotations.** Les fonds qui suivent des indices « marché total » intègrent en général assez tôt les grandes entreprises nouvellement cotées.

segments.src: - **Market-cap weighting amplifies size.** In a market-capitalization-weighted index, a very large new company can quickly become a meaningful share of the fund. Existing holdings are then diluted slightly, and the fund buys the new stock, which can add to demand around inclusion.
segments.tr: - **La pondération par capitalisation amplifie la taille.** Dans un indice pondéré par la capitalisation boursière, une très grande nouvelle entreprise peut rapidement représenter une part importante du fonds. Les positions existantes sont alors légèrement diluées, et le fonds achète le nouveau titre, ce qui peut accroître la demande autour de l'intégration.

segments.src: - **Float matters.** Many indexes weight companies by the shares actually available to the public, called the free float. A mega-listing that sells only a small percentage of its shares might start with a smaller index weight than its headline valuation suggests, and that weight can grow as insiders sell later.
segments.tr: - **Le flottant compte.** De nombreux indices pondèrent les entreprises selon les actions réellement disponibles auprès du public, appelées flottant libre. Une méga-cotation qui ne met en vente qu'un faible pourcentage de ses actions peut commencer avec un poids dans l'indice inférieur à ce que suggère sa valorisation affichée, et ce poids peut augmenter lorsque les initiés vendent par la suite.

segments.src: - **Concentration risk.** If several very large technology-related companies join the same index, the fund can become more concentrated in one theme than its owner realizes.
segments.tr: - **Risque de concentration.** Si plusieurs très grandes entreprises technologiques rejoignent le même indice, le fonds peut se concentrer davantage sur un seul thème que son détenteur ne le pense.

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Investors
segments.tr: ## Conseils pratiques pour les investisseurs

segments.src: - **Do not treat a debut as a guarantee.** First-day gains are common in popular offerings but not universal, and later performance has often lagged for investors who bought at high opening prices.
segments.tr: - **Ne considérez pas les débuts comme une garantie.** Les hausses du premier jour sont fréquentes pour les introductions populaires, mais pas systématiques, et la performance ultérieure a souvent été inférieure pour les investisseurs ayant acheté à des cours d'ouverture élevés.

segments.src: - **Read the prospectus.** The risk factors and capital structure sections are free and often more informative than news coverage.
segments.tr: - **Lisez le prospectus.** Les facteurs de risque et la structure du capital sont gratuits et souvent plus instructifs que la couverture médiatique.

segments.src: - **Check what you already own.** Look at your fund's top holdings and methodology to see how it treats new listings.
segments.tr: - **Vérifiez ce que vous détenez déjà.** Consultez les principales positions de votre fonds et sa méthodologie pour voir comment il traite les nouvelles cotations.

segments.src: - **Watch for lock-up expirations.** Dates are disclosed in the filing and can be periods of added volatility.
segments.tr: - **Surveillez les échéances des accords de blocage.** Les dates sont publiées dans le dépôt et peuvent correspondre à des périodes de volatilité accrue.

segments.src: - **Keep position sizes sensible.** Diversification across sectors and asset types remains the main protection against any single theme going wrong.
segments.tr: - **Dimensionnez raisonnablement vos positions.** La diversification entre secteurs et classes d'actifs reste la principale protection contre le mauvais tour joué par un thème unique.

segments.src: - **Match investments to your time horizon.** Short-term price moves around big events are hard to predict, and long-term investors generally do not need to react to each headline.
segments.tr: - **Adaptez vos placements à votre horizon de temps.** Les variations de cours à court terme autour de grands événements sont difficiles à prévoir, et les investisseurs de long terme n'ont généralement pas besoin de réagir à chaque nouvelle.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En conclusion

segments.src: A wave of mega-listings would mark a notable shift in market conditions, signaling that companies and their backers see public investors as ready to buy.
segments.tr: Une vague de méga-cotations marquerait un changement notable des conditions de marché, signalant que les entreprises et leurs soutiens considèrent les investisseurs publics comme prêts à acheter.

segments.src: For investors, the sensible approach is to understand the mechanics, read the disclosures and notice how index funds may quietly add exposure.
segments.tr: Pour les investisseurs, la démarche raisonnable consiste à comprendre les mécanismes, à lire les informations publiées et à remarquer comment les fonds indiciels peuvent discrètement ajouter une exposition.

segments.src: The effects on the wider market are uncertain, and no one can reliably time them.
segments.tr: Les effets sur le marché dans son ensemble restent incertains, et personne ne peut les anticiper de façon fiable.

segments.src: This article explains how an initial public offering (IPO) works, what the filings tell you, and why even people who only own index funds may end up with exposure.
segments.tr: Este artigo explica como funciona uma oferta pública inicial (IPO, na sigla em inglês), o que os documentos revelam e por que até quem possui apenas fundos indexados pode acabar exposto.

segments.src: It is general education, not investment advice, and the reports it discusses may change.
segments.tr: Trata-se de conteúdo educacional geral, não de recomendação de investimento, e os relatos discutidos podem mudar.

segments.src: ## What an IPO Actually Is
segments.tr: ## O Que É Realmente um IPO

segments.src: An initial public offering is the first time a company sells its shares to the general public on a stock exchange.
segments.tr: Uma oferta pública inicial é a primeira vez em que uma empresa vende suas ações ao público geral em uma bolsa de valores.

segments.src: Before that, the company is "private," and its owners are typically founders, employees, venture capital firms and other institutional backers.
segments.tr: Antes disso, a empresa é "privada", e seus donos são normalmente fundadores, funcionários, fundos de capital de risco e outros investidores institucionais.

segments.src: The basic steps look like this:
segments.tr: As etapas básicas são as seguintes:

segments.src: 1. **Preparation.** The company hires investment banks, called underwriters, and works with lawyers and auditors to assemble financial disclosures.
segments.tr: 1. **Preparação.** A empresa contrata bancos de investimento, chamados *underwriters* (coordenadores da oferta), e trabalha com advogados e auditores para montar as demonstrações financeiras.

segments.src: 2. **Filing.** The company submits a registration statement to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Companies can sometimes file confidentially at first, then make the document public before marketing the shares.
segments.tr: 2. **Registro.** A empresa apresenta uma declaração de registro à Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), a comissão de valores mobiliários dos EUA. Às vezes, as empresas podem registrar o pedido de forma confidencial no início e depois tornar o documento público antes de vender as ações.

segments.src: 3. **Roadshow.** Executives present to large institutional investors to gauge demand. This process is often called book-building.
segments.tr: 3. **Roadshow.** Os executivos apresentam a empresa a grandes investidores institucionais para medir a demanda. Esse processo costuma ser chamado de *book-building* (formação de livro de ofertas).

segments.src: 4. **Pricing.** The underwriters and the company set an offer price the night before trading begins, based on demand.
segments.tr: 4. **Precificação.** Os coordenadores e a empresa definem o preço de oferta na véspera do início das negociações, com base na demanda.

segments.src: 5. **First trade.** Shares begin trading on an exchange. The first-day price can differ sharply from the offer price.
segments.tr: 5. **Primeiro pregão.** As ações começam a ser negociadas em uma bolsa. O preço do primeiro dia pode diferir muito do preço de oferta.

segments.src: Some of the shares sold are "primary" shares, newly issued by the company to raise money.
segments.tr: Parte das ações vendidas são ações "primárias", emitidas pela própria empresa para captar recursos.

segments.src: Others are "secondary" shares, sold by existing holders who want to cash out.
segments.tr: Outras são ações "secundárias", vendidas por acionistas atuais que querem se desfazer de suas posições.

segments.src: The mix matters, because only primary shares put new capital in the company's hands.
segments.tr: A composição importa, porque apenas as ações primárias colocam novo capital nas mãos da empresa.

segments.src: ## What the Filings Reveal
segments.tr: ## O Que os Documentos Revelam

segments.src: The main public document is the prospectus, often known by its form name, the S-1.
segments.tr: O principal documento público é o prospecto, conhecido pelo nome do formulário, o S-1.

segments.src: Readers who want to look past the headlines can focus on a few sections:
segments.tr: Quem quer ir além das manchetes pode focar em algumas seções:

segments.src: - **Financial statements.** Revenue growth, profit or loss, cash burn and debt show whether the business can fund itself.
segments.tr: - **Demonstrações financeiras.** Crescimento da receita, lucro ou prejuízo, queima de caixa e dívidas mostram se o negócio consegue se financiar.

segments.src: - **Risk factors.** Companies must describe material risks, including competition, regulation, customer concentration and dependence on key suppliers.
segments.tr: - **Fatores de risco.** As empresas devem descrever riscos relevantes, incluindo concorrência, regulação, concentração de clientes e dependência de fornecedores-chave.

segments.src: - **Use of proceeds.** This explains whether the money will fund growth, repay debt or simply pass to selling shareholders.
segments.tr: - **Uso dos recursos.** Explica se o dinheiro financiará crescimento, quitará dívidas ou simplesmente será repassado aos acionistas vendedores.

segments.src: - **Capital structure.** Some companies issue multiple share classes, where founders hold extra voting power. That affects how much say ordinary shareholders have.
segments.tr: - **Estrutura de capital.** Algumas empresas emitem várias classes de ações, nas quais os fundadores têm poder de voto extra. Isso afeta quanto poder de decisão os acionistas comuns têm.

segments.src: - **Lock-up agreements.** Insiders often agree not to sell for a set period, commonly around 180 days. When it ends, a large number of shares can become tradable at once, which can affect the price.
segments.tr: - **Acordos de lock-up.** Os controladores costumam concordar em não vender por um período determinado, geralmente em torno de 180 dias. Quando o prazo termina, um grande número de ações pode passar a ser negociado de uma só vez, o que pode afetar o preço.

segments.src: - **Valuation context.** The price range implies a total company value. Comparing it with revenue and earnings, and with similar listed companies, helps show how much growth is already expected.
segments.tr: - **Contexto de valuation.** A faixa de preço implica um valor total para a empresa. Compará-la com receita, lucros e empresas listadas semelhantes ajuda a mostrar quanto crescimento já está precificado.

segments.src: ## Does a Flood of New Shares Pull Money From Other Stocks?
segments.tr: ## Uma Enxurrada de Novas Ações Tira Dinheiro de Outras Ações?

segments.src: The worry is a supply-and-demand one.
segments.tr: A preocupação é de oferta e demanda.

segments.src: If investors must buy billions of dollars of new shares, some may sell other holdings to pay for them.
segments.tr: Se os investidores precisarem comprar bilhões de dólares em novas ações, alguns podem vender outras posições para pagar por elas.

segments.src: In that case, a very large listing could weigh on existing stocks, particularly the ones most similar to the newcomer.
segments.tr: Nesse caso, uma listagem muito grande poderia pressionar as ações existentes, especialmente as mais parecidas com a recém-chegada.

segments.src: The reality is less clear-cut:
segments.tr: A realidade é menos categórica:

segments.src: - **Markets are very large.** U.S. stocks trade in the tens of billions of dollars every day, and total market value is measured in the tens of trillions. Even a very large offering is a small slice of that.
segments.tr: - **Os mercados são muito grandes.** As ações dos EUA movimentam dezenas de bilhões de dólares por dia, e o valor de mercado total se mede em dezenas de trilhões. Mesmo uma oferta muito grande é uma pequena fatia disso.

segments.src: - **Funding sources vary.** Money for an IPO can come from cash on the sidelines, new fund inflows or the proceeds of earlier sales, not only from selling other stocks.
segments.tr: - **As fontes de recursos variam.** O dinheiro para um IPO pode vir de caixa parado, de novos aportes em fundos ou dos recursos de vendas anteriores, não apenas da venda de outras ações.

segments.src: - **Sector effects are more plausible.** If the new company is in a crowded theme, such as AI, investors who want to own it may trim similar names. That effect is usually narrower than a market-wide drop.
segments.tr: - **Efeitos setoriais são mais plausíveis.** Se a nova empresa está em um tema concorrido, como IA, investidores que querem tê-la na carteira podem reduzir posições em nomes semelhantes. Esse efeito costuma ser mais restrito do que uma queda generalizada do mercado.

segments.src: - **Sentiment matters.** A strong debut can lift enthusiasm for the whole sector. A weak one can chill it. History includes examples of both.
segments.tr: - **O sentimento importa.** Uma estreia forte pode elevar o entusiasmo do setor como um todo. Uma fraca pode esfriá-lo. A história tem exemplos dos dois casos.

segments.src: In short, a big IPO can shift money around within a market.
segments.tr: Em resumo, um IPO grande pode deslocar dinheiro dentro do mercado.

segments.src: Whether it drains the market as a whole is much less certain, and it is hard to predict.
segments.tr: Se ele drena o mercado como um todo é bem menos certo, e difícil de prever.

segments.src: ## Why Index-Fund Holders May Still Be Exposed
segments.tr: ## Por Que Quem Tem Fundos Indexados Ainda Pode Estar Exposto

segments.src: Many people assume that owning a broad index fund means they have no stake in IPOs.
segments.tr: Muitas pessoas presumem que, ao possuir um fundo indexado amplo, não têm participação em IPOs.

segments.src: That is only partly true.
segments.tr: Isso só é verdade em parte.

segments.src: - **Index inclusion rules differ.** Some major indexes require a new company to trade for a set period, or to meet profitability and size tests, before it can join. Others add new listings more quickly. Rules vary by index provider, so check the methodology for the specific index your fund tracks.
segments.tr: - **As regras de inclusão em índices variam.** Alguns índices importantes exigem que uma nova empresa seja negociada por um período determinado, ou atenda a testes de lucratividade e porte, antes de entrar. Outros incluem novas listagens mais rapidamente. As regras variam conforme o provedor do índice, então verifique a metodologia do índice que o seu fundo acompanha.

segments.src: - **Total-market funds add new listings.** Funds that follow broad "total market" indexes tend to take in newly listed large companies relatively soon after they list.
segments.tr: - **Fundos de mercado total incluem novas listagens.** Fundos que acompanham índices de "mercado total" tendem a incorporar grandes empresas recém-listadas relativamente logo após a estreia.

segments.src: - **Market-cap weighting amplifies size.** In a market-capitalization-weighted index, a very large new company can quickly become a meaningful share of the fund. Existing holdings are then diluted slightly, and the fund buys the new stock, which can add to demand around inclusion.
segments.tr: - **A ponderação por valor de mercado amplifica o porte.** Em um índice ponderado por capitalização de mercado, uma nova empresa muito grande pode rapidamente se tornar uma parcela relevante do fundo. As posições existentes são então um pouco diluídas, e o fundo compra a nova ação, o que pode aumentar a demanda em torno da inclusão.

segments.src: - **Float matters.** Many indexes weight companies by the shares actually available to the public, called the free float. A mega-listing that sells only a small percentage of its shares might start with a smaller index weight than its headline valuation suggests, and that weight can grow as insiders sell later.
segments.tr: - **O free float importa.** Muitos índices ponderam as empresas pelas ações efetivamente disponíveis ao público, chamadas de *free float*. Uma megalistagem que vende apenas uma pequena porcentagem de suas ações pode começar com um peso no índice menor do que sugere seu valuation anunciado, e esse peso pode crescer conforme os controladores vendam mais tarde.

segments.src: - **Concentration risk.** If several very large technology-related companies join the same index, the fund can become more concentrated in one theme than its owner realizes.
segments.tr: - **Risco de concentração.** Se várias empresas de tecnologia de grande porte entrarem no mesmo índice, o fundo pode ficar mais concentrado em um tema do que seu investidor imagina.

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Investors
segments.tr: ## Conclusões Práticas para Investidores

segments.src: - **Do not treat a debut as a guarantee.** First-day gains are common in popular offerings but not universal, and later performance has often lagged for investors who bought at high opening prices.
segments.tr: - **Não trate a estreia como garantia.** Ganhos no primeiro dia são comuns em ofertas populares, mas não universais, e o desempenho posterior muitas vezes ficou atrás para quem comprou a preços de abertura altos.

segments.src: - **Read the prospectus.** The risk factors and capital structure sections are free and often more informative than news coverage.
segments.tr: - **Leia o prospecto.** As seções de fatores de risco e de estrutura de capital são gratuitas e costumam ser mais informativas do que a cobertura jornalística.

segments.src: - **Check what you already own.** Look at your fund's top holdings and methodology to see how it treats new listings.
segments.tr: - **Confira o que você já possui.** Veja as principais posições do seu fundo e a metodologia para entender como ele trata novas listagens.

segments.src: - **Watch for lock-up expirations.** Dates are disclosed in the filing and can be periods of added volatility.
segments.tr: - **Fique atento aos vencimentos de lock-up.** As datas são divulgadas no registro e podem representar períodos de maior volatilidade.

segments.src: - **Keep position sizes sensible.** Diversification across sectors and asset types remains the main protection against any single theme going wrong.
segments.tr: - **Mantenha o tamanho das posições sensato.** A diversificação entre setores e tipos de ativos continua sendo a principal proteção contra o erro de qualquer tema isolado.

segments.src: - **Match investments to your time horizon.** Short-term price moves around big events are hard to predict, and long-term investors generally do not need to react to each headline.
segments.tr: - **Alinhe os investimentos ao seu horizonte de tempo.** Movimentos de curto prazo em torno de grandes eventos são difíceis de prever, e investidores de longo prazo geralmente não precisam reagir a cada manchete.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusão

segments.src: A wave of mega-listings would mark a notable shift in market conditions, signaling that companies and their backers see public investors as ready to buy.
segments.tr: Uma onda de megalistagens marcaria uma mudança relevante nas condições de mercado, sinalizando que as empresas e seus apoiadores veem os investidores públicos como prontos para comprar.

segments.src: For investors, the sensible approach is to understand the mechanics, read the disclosures and notice how index funds may quietly add exposure.
segments.tr: Para o investidor, a abordagem sensata é entender a mecânica, ler as divulgações e perceber como os fundos indexados podem acrescentar exposição discretamente.

segments.src: The effects on the wider market are uncertain, and no one can reliably time them.
segments.tr: Os efeitos sobre o mercado como um todo são incertos, e ninguém consegue acertar o momento com segurança.

segments.src: ## What an IPO Actually Is
segments.tr: ## Apa Sebenarnya IPO Itu

segments.src: An initial public offering is the first time a company sells its shares to the general public on a stock exchange.
segments.tr: Penawaran umum perdana adalah saat pertama kalinya sebuah perusahaan menjual sahamnya kepada publik umum di bursa efek.

segments.src: Before that, the company is "private," and its owners are typically founders, employees, venture capital firms and other institutional backers.
segments.tr: Sebelumnya, perusahaan bersifat "privat", dan pemiliknya biasanya adalah pendiri, karyawan, perusahaan modal ventura, dan pendukung institusi lainnya.

segments.src: The basic steps look like this:
segments.tr: Langkah dasarnya adalah sebagai berikut:

segments.src: 1. **Preparation.** The company hires investment banks, called underwriters, and works with lawyers and auditors to assemble financial disclosures.
segments.tr: 1. **Persiapan.** Perusahaan menyewa bank investasi, yang disebut penjamin emisi (underwriter), dan bekerja sama dengan pengacara serta auditor untuk menyusun laporan keuangan.

segments.src: 2. **Filing.** The company submits a registration statement to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Companies can sometimes file confidentially at first, then make the document public before marketing the shares.
segments.tr: 2. **Pendaftaran.** Perusahaan mengajukan pernyataan pendaftaran ke Komisi Sekuritas dan Bursa Amerika Serikat (U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission/SEC). Perusahaan terkadang dapat mengajukan secara rahasia pada awalnya, lalu mempublikasikan dokumen tersebut sebelum memasarkan sahamnya.

segments.src: 3. **Roadshow.** Executives present to large institutional investors to gauge demand. This process is often called book-building.
segments.tr: 3. **Roadshow.** Eksekutif memaparkan rencana kepada investor institusi besar untuk mengukur permintaan. Proses ini sering disebut book-building.

segments.src: 4. **Pricing.** The underwriters and the company set an offer price the night before trading begins, based on demand.
segments.tr: 4. **Penetapan harga.** Penjamin emisi dan perusahaan menetapkan harga penawaran pada malam sebelum perdagangan dimulai, berdasarkan permintaan.

segments.src: 5. **First trade.** Shares begin trading on an exchange. The first-day price can differ sharply from the offer price.
segments.tr: 5. **Perdagangan pertama.** Saham mulai diperdagangkan di bursa. Harga hari pertama dapat sangat berbeda dari harga penawaran.

segments.src: Some of the shares sold are "primary" shares, newly issued by the company to raise money.
segments.tr: Sebagian saham yang dijual adalah saham "primer", yang baru diterbitkan oleh perusahaan untuk menghimpun dana.

segments.src: Others are "secondary" shares, sold by existing holders who want to cash out.
segments.tr: Sisanya adalah saham "sekunder", yang dijual oleh pemegang saham yang ingin mencairkan investasinya.

segments.src: The mix matters, because only primary shares put new capital in the company's hands.
segments.tr: Komposisinya penting, karena hanya saham primer yang memasukkan modal baru ke tangan perusahaan.

segments.src: ## What the Filings Reveal
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Diungkap Dokumen Pendaftaran

segments.src: The main public document is the prospectus, often known by its form name, the S-1.
segments.tr: Dokumen publik utamanya adalah prospektus, yang sering dikenal dengan nama formulirnya, S-1.

segments.src: Readers who want to look past the headlines can focus on a few sections:
segments.tr: Pembaca yang ingin melampaui judul berita dapat berfokus pada beberapa bagian:

segments.src: - **Financial statements.** Revenue growth, profit or loss, cash burn and debt show whether the business can fund itself.
segments.tr: - **Laporan keuangan.** Pertumbuhan pendapatan, laba atau rugi, arus kas keluar, dan utang menunjukkan apakah bisnis dapat membiayai dirinya sendiri.

segments.src: - **Risk factors.** Companies must describe material risks, including competition, regulation, customer concentration and dependence on key suppliers.
segments.tr: - **Faktor risiko.** Perusahaan wajib menjelaskan risiko material, termasuk persaingan, regulasi, konsentrasi pelanggan, dan ketergantungan pada pemasok utama.

segments.src: - **Use of proceeds.** This explains whether the money will fund growth, repay debt or simply pass to selling shareholders.
segments.tr: - **Penggunaan dana.** Bagian ini menjelaskan apakah dana akan digunakan untuk pertumbuhan, melunasi utang, atau hanya diberikan kepada pemegang saham yang menjual.

segments.src: - **Capital structure.** Some companies issue multiple share classes, where founders hold extra voting power. That affects how much say ordinary shareholders have.
segments.tr: - **Struktur modal.** Beberapa perusahaan menerbitkan beberapa kelas saham, di mana pendiri memiliki hak suara tambahan. Hal ini memengaruhi seberapa besar suara pemegang saham biasa.

segments.src: - **Lock-up agreements.** Insiders often agree not to sell for a set period, commonly around 180 days. When it ends, a large number of shares can become tradable at once, which can affect the price.
segments.tr: - **Perjanjian lock-up.** Orang dalam sering setuju untuk tidak menjual dalam jangka waktu tertentu, biasanya sekitar 180 hari. Saat masa ini berakhir, sejumlah besar saham dapat langsung diperdagangkan, yang dapat memengaruhi harga.

segments.src: - **Valuation context.** The price range implies a total company value. Comparing it with revenue and earnings, and with similar listed companies, helps show how much growth is already expected.
segments.tr: - **Konteks valuasi.** Rentang harga menyiratkan total nilai perusahaan. Membandingkannya dengan pendapatan dan laba, serta dengan perusahaan terdaftar yang serupa, membantu menunjukkan seberapa besar pertumbuhan yang sudah diharapkan.

segments.src: ## Does a Flood of New Shares Pull Money From Other Stocks?
segments.tr: ## Apakah Banjir Saham Baru Menarik Dana dari Saham Lain?

segments.src: The worry is a supply-and-demand one.
segments.tr: Kekhawatirannya bersifat penawaran dan permintaan.

segments.src: If investors must buy billions of dollars of new shares, some may sell other holdings to pay for them.
segments.tr: Jika investor harus membeli saham baru senilai miliaran dolar, sebagian mungkin menjual kepemilikan lain untuk membayarnya.

segments.src: In that case, a very large listing could weigh on existing stocks, particularly the ones most similar to the newcomer.
segments.tr: Dalam kasus itu, pencatatan berskala besar dapat menekan saham yang sudah ada, terutama yang paling mirip dengan pendatang baru.

segments.src: The reality is less clear-cut:
segments.tr: Kenyataannya tidak sejelas itu:

segments.src: - **Markets are very large.** U.S. stocks trade in the tens of billions of dollars every day, and total market value is measured in the tens of trillions. Even a very large offering is a small slice of that.
segments.tr: - **Pasarnya sangat besar.** Saham AS diperdagangkan dalam puluhan miliar dolar setiap hari, dan total nilai pasar diukur dalam puluhan triliun. Bahkan penawaran yang sangat besar hanyalah sebagian kecil dari itu.

segments.src: - **Funding sources vary.** Money for an IPO can come from cash on the sidelines, new fund inflows or the proceeds of earlier sales, not only from selling other stocks.
segments.tr: - **Sumber dana bervariasi.** Dana untuk IPO dapat berasal dari kas yang menganggur, arus masuk baru ke reksa dana, atau hasil penjualan sebelumnya, tidak hanya dari menjual saham lain.

segments.src: - **Sector effects are more plausible.** If the new company is in a crowded theme, such as AI, investors who want to own it may trim similar names. That effect is usually narrower than a market-wide drop.
segments.tr: - **Efek sektor lebih masuk akal.** Jika perusahaan baru berada di tema yang ramai, seperti AI, investor yang ingin memilikinya mungkin memangkas saham sejenis. Efek ini biasanya lebih sempit daripada penurunan seluruh pasar.

segments.src: - **Sentiment matters.** A strong debut can lift enthusiasm for the whole sector. A weak one can chill it. History includes examples of both.
segments.tr: - **Sentimen penting.** Debut yang kuat dapat meningkatkan antusiasme untuk seluruh sektor. Debut yang lemah dapat mendinginkannya. Sejarah mencatat contoh keduanya.

segments.src: In short, a big IPO can shift money around within a market.
segments.tr: Singkatnya, IPO besar dapat memindahkan dana di dalam pasar.

segments.src: Whether it drains the market as a whole is much less certain, and it is hard to predict.
segments.tr: Apakah itu menguras pasar secara keseluruhan jauh lebih tidak pasti, dan sulit diprediksi.

segments.src: ## Why Index-Fund Holders May Still Be Exposed
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Pemegang Reksa Dana Indeks Tetap Bisa Terpapar

segments.src: Many people assume that owning a broad index fund means they have no stake in IPOs.
segments.tr: Banyak orang mengira bahwa memiliki reksa dana indeks yang luas berarti tidak memiliki kepentingan dalam IPO.

segments.src: That is only partly true.
segments.tr: Itu hanya benar sebagian.

segments.src: - **Index inclusion rules differ.** Some major indexes require a new company to trade for a set period, or to meet profitability and size tests, before it can join. Others add new listings more quickly. Rules vary by index provider, so check the methodology for the specific index your fund tracks.
segments.tr: - **Aturan masuknya indeks berbeda-beda.** Beberapa indeks utama mensyaratkan perusahaan baru diperdagangkan dalam jangka waktu tertentu, atau memenuhi uji profitabilitas dan ukuran, sebelum dapat bergabung. Yang lain menambahkan pencatatan baru dengan lebih cepat. Aturannya bervariasi menurut penyedia indeks, jadi periksa metodologi untuk indeks spesifik yang dilacak reksa dana Anda.

segments.src: - **Total-market funds add new listings.** Funds that follow broad "total market" indexes tend to take in newly listed large companies relatively soon after they list.
segments.tr: - **Reksa dana pasar total menambahkan pencatatan baru.** Reksa dana yang mengikuti indeks "pasar total" yang luas cenderung memasukkan perusahaan besar yang baru tercatat relatif cepat setelah pencatatan.

segments.src: - **Market-cap weighting amplifies size.** In a market-capitalization-weighted index, a very large new company can quickly become a meaningful share of the fund. Existing holdings are then diluted slightly, and the fund buys the new stock, which can add to demand around inclusion.
segments.tr: - **Pembobotan kapitalisasi pasar memperkuat ukuran.** Dalam indeks yang diberi bobot kapitalisasi pasar, perusahaan baru yang sangat besar dapat dengan cepat menjadi porsi yang berarti dari reksa dana. Kepemilikan yang ada kemudian sedikit terdilusi, dan reksa dana membeli saham baru tersebut, yang dapat menambah permintaan di sekitar waktu masuknya indeks.

segments.src: - **Float matters.** Many indexes weight companies by the shares actually available to the public, called the free float. A mega-listing that sells only a small percentage of its shares might start with a smaller index weight than its headline valuation suggests, and that weight can grow as insiders sell later.
segments.tr: - **Free float itu penting.** Banyak indeks memberi bobot pada perusahaan berdasarkan saham yang benar-benar tersedia untuk publik, yang disebut free float. Mega-listing yang hanya menjual sebagian kecil sahamnya mungkin memulai dengan bobot indeks yang lebih kecil daripada yang disiratkan oleh valuasi utamanya, dan bobot itu dapat tumbuh ketika orang dalam menjual kemudian.

segments.src: - **Concentration risk.** If several very large technology-related companies join the same index, the fund can become more concentrated in one theme than its owner realizes.
segments.tr: - **Risiko konsentrasi.** Jika beberapa perusahaan teknologi berskala sangat besar bergabung dalam indeks yang sama, reksa dana dapat menjadi lebih terkonsentrasi pada satu tema daripada yang disadari pemiliknya.

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Investors
segments.tr: ## Poin Praktis bagi Investor

segments.src: - **Do not treat a debut as a guarantee.** First-day gains are common in popular offerings but not universal, and later performance has often lagged for investors who bought at high opening prices.
segments.tr: - **Jangan anggap debut sebagai jaminan.** Keuntungan hari pertama umum terjadi pada penawaran yang populer tetapi tidak selalu, dan kinerja jangka panjangnya sering tertinggal bagi investor yang membeli di harga pembukaan tinggi.

segments.src: - **Read the prospectus.** The risk factors and capital structure sections are free and often more informative than news coverage.
segments.tr: - **Baca prospektusnya.** Bagian faktor risiko dan struktur modal gratis dan sering kali lebih informatif daripada liputan berita.

segments.src: - **Check what you already own.** Look at your fund's top holdings and methodology to see how it treats new listings.
segments.tr: - **Periksa apa yang sudah Anda miliki.** Lihat kepemilikan teratas reksa dana Anda dan metodologinya untuk melihat cara perlakuannya terhadap pencatatan baru.

segments.src: - **Watch for lock-up expirations.** Dates are disclosed in the filing and can be periods of added volatility.
segments.tr: - **Perhatikan berakhirnya lock-up.** Tanggalnya diungkapkan dalam dokumen pendaftaran dan dapat menjadi periode volatilitas tambahan.

segments.src: - **Keep position sizes sensible.** Diversification across sectors and asset types remains the main protection against any single theme going wrong.
segments.tr: - **Jaga ukuran posisi tetap wajar.** Diversifikasi lintas sektor dan jenis aset tetap menjadi perlindungan utama terhadap tema tunggal yang gagal.

segments.src: - **Match investments to your time horizon.** Short-term price moves around big events are hard to predict, and long-term investors generally do not need to react to each headline.
segments.tr: - **Sesuaikan investasi dengan horizon waktu Anda.** Pergerakan harga jangka pendek di sekitar peristiwa besar sulit diprediksi, dan investor jangka panjang umumnya tidak perlu bereaksi terhadap setiap berita.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: A wave of mega-listings would mark a notable shift in market conditions, signaling that companies and their backers see public investors as ready to buy.
segments.tr: Gelombang mega-listing akan menandai pergeseran penting dalam kondisi pasar, yang menandakan bahwa perusahaan dan pendukungnya melihat investor publik siap membeli.

segments.src: For investors, the sensible approach is to understand the mechanics, read the disclosures and notice how index funds may quietly add exposure.

segments.src: The effects on the wider market are uncertain, and no one can reliably time them.
segments.tr: Dampak terhadap pasar yang lebih luas tidak pasti, dan tidak seorang pun dapat memprediksi waktunya dengan andal.

ja.title: IPO市場の再開：大型上場の波が投資家とインデックスファンドにもたらすもの

segments.src: When large private companies talk about going public, markets pay attention.
segments.tr: 大手の非上場企業が株式公開を語ると、市場は注目します。

segments.src: Recent reports that several high-profile artificial intelligence companies are preparing or considering stock market debuts have revived an old Wall Street question: if a flood of new shares arrives, does money leave existing stocks to make room for it?
segments.tr: 複数の注目度の高い人工知能企業が株式市場への上場を準備中または検討中だという最近の報道は、古くからのウォール街の問いを再び呼び起こしました。新株が大量に供給されたとき、既存の銘柄から資金が流出してその分の余地を作るのか、という問いです。

segments.src: This article explains how an initial public offering (IPO) works, what the filings tell you, and why even people who only own index funds may end up with exposure.
segments.tr: この記事では、新規株式公開（IPO）の仕組み、目論見書から読み取れること、そしてインデックスファンドだけを保有している人でも結果的にエクスポージャーを持つことになる理由を説明します。

segments.src: It is general education, not investment advice, and the reports it discusses may change.
segments.tr: これは一般的な教育目的の情報であり、投資助言ではありません。取り上げている報道の内容は変わる可能性があります。

segments.src: ## What an IPO Actually Is
segments.tr: ## IPOとは何か

segments.src: An initial public offering is the first time a company sells its shares to the general public on a stock exchange.
segments.tr: 新規株式公開とは、企業が株式取引所を通じて一般投資家に初めて株式を売り出すことです。

segments.src: Before that, the company is "private," and its owners are typically founders, employees, venture capital firms and other institutional backers.
segments.tr: それ以前の企業は「非上場」であり、その所有者は通常、創業者、従業員、ベンチャーキャピタルなどの機関投資家です。

segments.src: The basic steps look like this:
segments.tr: 基本的な流れは次のとおりです。

segments.src: 1. **Preparation.** The company hires investment banks, called underwriters, and works with lawyers and auditors to assemble financial disclosures.
segments.tr: 1. **準備。** 企業は引受証券会社（アンダーライター）を起用し、弁護士や監査人とともに財務開示資料を作成します。

segments.src: 2. **Filing.** The company submits a registration statement to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Companies can sometimes file confidentially at first, then make the document public before marketing the shares.
segments.tr: 2. **届出。** 企業は米国証券取引委員会（SEC）に登録届出書を提出します。企業によっては最初は非公開で届け出て、株式の販売を開始する前に書類を公開することもできます。

segments.src: 3. **Roadshow.** Executives present to large institutional investors to gauge demand. This process is often called book-building.
segments.tr: 3. **ロードショー。** 経営陣が大口の機関投資家に説明し、需要を測ります。このプロセスはしばしばブックビルディングと呼ばれます。

segments.src: 4. **Pricing.** The underwriters and the company set an offer price the night before trading begins, based on demand.
segments.tr: 4. **価格決定。** 引受証券会社と企業は、需要に基づいて取引開始前日の夜に売出価格を決定します。

segments.src: 5. **First trade.** Shares begin trading on an exchange. The first-day price can differ sharply from the offer price.
segments.tr: 5. **初取引。** 株式が取引所で取引を開始します。初日の株価は売出価格と大きく異なることがあります。

segments.src: Some of the shares sold are "primary" shares, newly issued by the company to raise money.
segments.tr: 売り出される株式の一部は「主幹事株」（プライマリー株式）、つまり企業が資金を調達するために新たに発行する株式です。

segments.src: Others are "secondary" shares, sold by existing holders who want to cash out.
segments.tr: 残りは「売出株」（セカンダリー株式）、つまり現在の株主が現金化するために売却する株式です。

segments.src: The mix matters, because only primary shares put new capital in the company's hands.
segments.tr: 新たな資本が企業の手元に入るのは主幹事株だけなので、この内訳は重要です。

segments.src: ## What the Filings Reveal
segments.tr: ## 目論見書から分かること

segments.src: The main public document is the prospectus, often known by its form name, the S-1.
segments.tr: 主要な公開文書は目論見書で、フォーム名のS-1として知られることが多いです。

segments.src: Readers who want to look past the headlines can focus on a few sections:
segments.tr: 見出しの先を読みたい読者は、いくつかのセクションに注目するとよいでしょう。

segments.src: - **Financial statements.** Revenue growth, profit or loss, cash burn and debt show whether the business can fund itself.
segments.tr: - **財務諸表。** 売上高の成長、損益、キャッシュの減少、負債は、事業が自力で資金を賄えるかどうかを示します。

segments.src: - **Risk factors.** Companies must describe material risks, including competition, regulation, customer concentration and dependence on key suppliers.
segments.tr: - **リスク要因。** 企業は、競争、規制、顧客の集中、主要サプライヤーへの依存などの重要なリスクを記述しなければなりません。

segments.src: - **Use of proceeds.** This explains whether the money will fund growth, repay debt or simply pass to selling shareholders.
segments.tr: - **資金使途。** 調達資金が成長投資に使われるのか、債務の返済に充てられるのか、あるいは売り手株主に渡るだけなのかを説明します。

segments.src: - **Capital structure.** Some companies issue multiple share classes, where founders hold extra voting power. That affects how much say ordinary shareholders have.
segments.tr: - **資本構成。** 創業者が追加の議決権を持つ複数の種類株式を発行する企業もあります。これは一般株主の発言力に影響します。

segments.src: - **Lock-up agreements.** Insiders often agree not to sell for a set period, commonly around 180 days. When it ends, a large number of shares can become tradable at once, which can affect the price.
segments.tr: - **ロックアップ契約。** インサイダーは、一定期間（一般的には約180日）売却しないことに同意することが多いです。期間が終わると多数の株式が一斉に売買可能になり、株価に影響することがあります。

segments.src: - **Valuation context.** The price range implies a total company value. Comparing it with revenue and earnings, and with similar listed companies, helps show how much growth is already expected.
segments.tr: - **バリュエーションの前提。** 価格レンジは企業全体の価値を示唆します。売上高や利益、そして類似する上場企業と比較することで、すでにどれほどの成長が織り込まれているかが分かります。

segments.src: ## Does a Flood of New Shares Pull Money From Other Stocks?
segments.tr: ## 新株の大量供給は他の銘柄から資金を奪うのか？

segments.src: The worry is a supply-and-demand one.
segments.tr: 懸念は需給の問題です。

segments.src: If investors must buy billions of dollars of new shares, some may sell other holdings to pay for them.
segments.tr: 投資家が数十億ドル規模の新株を買う必要がある場合、その代金を払うために他の保有株を売る人が出るかもしれません。

segments.src: In that case, a very large listing could weigh on existing stocks, particularly the ones most similar to the newcomer.
segments.tr: その場合、非常に大きな上場は既存の銘柄、特に新規上場銘柄に最も似た銘柄を圧迫する可能性があります。

segments.src: The reality is less clear-cut:
segments.tr: 実際はもっと単純ではありません。

segments.src: - **Markets are very large.** U.S. stocks trade in the tens of billions of dollars every day, and total market value is measured in the tens of trillions. Even a very large offering is a small slice of that.
segments.tr: - **市場は非常に大きい。** 米国株は毎日数百億ドル規模で取引され、時価総額の合計は数十兆ドルに達します。非常に大きな売出しでも、その中のわずかな一部に過ぎません。

segments.src: - **Funding sources vary.** Money for an IPO can come from cash on the sidelines, new fund inflows or the proceeds of earlier sales, not only from selling other stocks.
segments.tr: - **資金源はさまざまである。** IPOの資金は、他の銘柄の売却に限らず、待機中の現金、ファンドへの新規資金流入、あるいは以前の売却による収益から来ることもあります。

segments.src: - **Sector effects are more plausible.** If the new company is in a crowded theme, such as AI, investors who want to own it may trim similar names. That effect is usually narrower than a market-wide drop.
segments.tr: - **セクターへの影響はより現実的である。** 新企業がAIのような混雑したテーマに属する場合、その株を保有したい投資家は、類似銘柄を減らすかもしれません。この影響は通常、市場全体の下落よりも狭い範囲にとどまります。

segments.src: - **Sentiment matters.** A strong debut can lift enthusiasm for the whole sector. A weak one can chill it. History includes examples of both.
segments.tr: - **センチメントが重要である。** 好調な初日の取引は業界全体への期待を高めることがあります。振るわなければ冷え込ませることもあります。歴史にはどちらの例もあります。

segments.src: In short, a big IPO can shift money around within a market.
segments.tr: 要するに、大型IPOは市場内で資金を移動させることがあります。

segments.src: Whether it drains the market as a whole is much less certain, and it is hard to predict.
segments.tr: 市場全体から資金を吸い上げるかどうかは、はるかに不確実で、予測は困難です。

segments.src: ## Why Index-Fund Holders May Still Be Exposed
segments.tr: ## インデックスファンドの保有者が依然としてエクスポージャーを持つ理由

segments.src: Many people assume that owning a broad index fund means they have no stake in IPOs.
segments.tr: 多くの人は、広範なインデックスファンドを保有していればIPOには関わりがないと考えています。

segments.src: That is only partly true.
segments.tr: それは一部しか正しくありません。

segments.src: - **Index inclusion rules differ.** Some major indexes require a new company to trade for a set period, or to meet profitability and size tests, before it can join. Others add new listings more quickly. Rules vary by index provider, so check the methodology for the specific index your fund tracks.
segments.tr: - **インデックスへの組入れルールは異なる。** 主要なインデックスの中には、新規企業が組み入れられる前に一定期間の取引や、収益性・規模の基準を満たすことを求めるものがあります。より早く新規上場を追加するインデックスもあります。ルールはインデックス提供会社ごとに異なるため、保有するファンドが連動する特定のインデックスの算出方法を確認してください。

segments.src: - **Total-market funds add new listings.** Funds that follow broad "total market" indexes tend to take in newly listed large companies relatively soon after they list.
segments.tr: - **トータルマーケット型ファンドは新規上場を加える。** 「トータルマーケット」型の広範なインデックスに連動するファンドは、大型の新規上場企業を上場後比較的早い時期に組み入れる傾向があります。

segments.src: - **Market-cap weighting amplifies size.** In a market-capitalization-weighted index, a very large new company can quickly become a meaningful share of the fund. Existing holdings are then diluted slightly, and the fund buys the new stock, which can add to demand around inclusion.
segments.tr: - **時価総額加重は規模を増幅する。** 時価総額加重型インデックスでは、非常に大きな新規企業がすぐにファンドの中で無視できない比率を占めることがあります。既存の保有銘柄は若干希薄化され、ファンドは新株を買い付けるため、組入れ前後の需要を押し上げることがあります。

segments.src: - **Float matters.** Many indexes weight companies by the shares actually available to the public, called the free float. A mega-listing that sells only a small percentage of its shares might start with a smaller index weight than its headline valuation suggests, and that weight can grow as insiders sell later.
segments.tr: - **浮動株が重要である。** 多くのインデックスは、企業の時価総額ではなく、実際に一般に売買可能な株式数である浮動株（フリーフロート）で加重します。株式の一部しか売り出さない大型上場は、見出しのバリュエーションから想定されるよりも小さいインデックス比率で始まることがあり、その比率はインサイダーが後に売却するにつれて拡大することがあります。

segments.src: - **Concentration risk.** If several very large technology-related companies join the same index, the fund can become more concentrated in one theme than its owner realizes.
segments.tr: - **集中リスク。** 非常に大規模なテクノロジー関連企業が複数同じインデックスに加わると、ファンドは保有者が認識している以上に一つのテーマに集中することがあります。

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Investors
segments.tr: ## 投資家への実践的なポイント

segments.src: - **Do not treat a debut as a guarantee.** First-day gains are common in popular offerings but not universal, and later performance has often lagged for investors who bought at high opening prices.
segments.tr: - **初日の上昇を保証とみなさない。** 人気のあるIPOでは初日の上昇はよくありますが、常にそうとは限らず、高い始値で買った投資家の後の成績は振るわないことがよくあります。

segments.src: - **Read the prospectus.** The risk factors and capital structure sections are free and often more informative than news coverage.
segments.tr: - **目論見書を読む。** リスク要因と資本構成のセクションは無料で、ニュース報道よりも多くの情報を提供することが多いです。

segments.src: - **Check what you already own.** Look at your fund's top holdings and methodology to see how it treats new listings.
segments.tr: - **すでに保有しているものを確認する。** ファンドの上位保有銘柄と算出方法を見て、新規上場をどのように扱っているかを確認してください。

segments.src: - **Watch for lock-up expirations.** Dates are disclosed in the filing and can be periods of added volatility.
segments.tr: - **ロックアップ期間の満了に注意する。** 日付は届出書に開示されており、その期間には価格変動が大きくなることがあります。

segments.src: - **Keep position sizes sensible.** Diversification across sectors and asset types remains the main protection against any single theme going wrong.
segments.tr: - **ポジションサイズを適切に保つ。** セクターや資産クラスをまたいだ分散投資が、単一のテーマが外れた場合に対する主要な防御策であり続けます。

segments.src: - **Match investments to your time horizon.** Short-term price moves around big events are hard to predict, and long-term investors generally do not need to react to each headline.
segments.tr: - **投資期間に合わせて投資する。** 大きな出来事の前後の短期的な価格変動は予測が困難で、長期投資家は一つひとつの見出しに反応する必要は一般的にありません。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: A wave of mega-listings would mark a notable shift in market conditions, signaling that companies and their backers see public investors as ready to buy.
segments.tr: 大型上場の波は、企業とその出資者が公開市場の投資家が購入する準備ができていると見ていることを示し、市場環境の注目すべき変化を意味するでしょう。

segments.src: For investors, the sensible approach is to understand the mechanics, read the disclosures and notice how index funds may quietly add exposure.

segments.tr: Dieser Artikel erklärt, wie ein Börsengang (Initial Public Offering, IPO) funktioniert, was die Unterlagen verraten und warum selbst Menschen, die nur Indexfonds besitzen, letztlich Engagement erhalten können.

segments.src: It is general education, not investment advice, and the reports it discusses may change.

segments.src: ## What an IPO Actually Is
segments.tr: ## Was ein IPO eigentlich ist

segments.src: An initial public offering is the first time a company sells its shares to the general public on a stock exchange.
segments.tr: Ein Börsengang (Initial Public Offering) ist das erste Mal, dass ein Unternehmen seine Aktien an einer Börse an die breite Öffentlichkeit verkauft.

segments.src: Before that, the company is "private," and its owners are typically founders, employees, venture capital firms and other institutional backers.
segments.tr: Davor ist das Unternehmen "privat", und seine Eigentümer sind typischerweise Gründer, Mitarbeiter, Risikokapitalgeber und andere institutionelle Geldgeber.

segments.src: The basic steps look like this:
segments.tr: Die grundlegenden Schritte sehen so aus:

segments.src: 1. **Preparation.** The company hires investment banks, called underwriters, and works with lawyers and auditors to assemble financial disclosures.
segments.tr: 1. **Vorbereitung.** Das Unternehmen beauftragt Investmentbanken, sogenannte Underwriter, und arbeitet mit Anwälten und Wirtschaftsprüfern zusammen, um die Finanzinformationen zu erstellen.

segments.src: 2. **Filing.** The company submits a registration statement to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Companies can sometimes file confidentially at first, then make the document public before marketing the shares.
segments.tr: 2. **Einreichung.** Das Unternehmen reicht eine Registrierungserklärung bei der U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) ein. Unternehmen können zunächst manchmal vertraulich einreichen und das Dokument dann öffentlich machen, bevor die Aktien vermarktet werden.

segments.src: 3. **Roadshow.** Executives present to large institutional investors to gauge demand. This process is often called book-building.
segments.tr: 3. **Roadshow.** Führungskräfte präsentieren sich großen institutionellen Investoren, um die Nachfrage einzuschätzen. Dieser Prozess wird oft als Book-Building bezeichnet.

segments.src: 4. **Pricing.** The underwriters and the company set an offer price the night before trading begins, based on demand.
segments.tr: 4. **Preisfestsetzung.** Die Underwriter und das Unternehmen legen den Angebotspreis am Abend vor dem Handelsbeginn fest, basierend auf der Nachfrage.

segments.src: 5. **First trade.** Shares begin trading on an exchange. The first-day price can differ sharply from the offer price.
segments.tr: 5. **Erster Handel.** Die Aktien werden an einer Börse gehandelt. Der Kurs am ersten Handelstag kann deutlich vom Angebotspreis abweichen.

segments.src: Some of the shares sold are "primary" shares, newly issued by the company to raise money.
segments.tr: Ein Teil der verkauften Aktien sind "Primäraktien", die das Unternehmen neu ausgibt, um Geld zu beschaffen.

segments.src: Others are "secondary" shares, sold by existing holders who want to cash out.
segments.tr: Andere sind "Sekundäraktien", die von bisherigen Inhabern verkauft werden, die aussteigen möchten.

segments.src: The mix matters, because only primary shares put new capital in the company's hands.
segments.tr: Die Zusammensetzung ist wichtig, denn nur Primäraktien bringen neues Kapital in die Hände des Unternehmens.

segments.src: ## What the Filings Reveal
segments.tr: ## Was die Unterlagen offenlegen

segments.src: The main public document is the prospectus, often known by its form name, the S-1.
segments.tr: Das wichtigste öffentliche Dokument ist der Prospekt, oft unter seiner Formbezeichnung S-1 bekannt.

segments.src: Readers who want to look past the headlines can focus on a few sections:
segments.tr: Wer über die Schlagzeilen hinausblicken möchte, kann sich auf einige Abschnitte konzentrieren:

segments.src: - **Financial statements.** Revenue growth, profit or loss, cash burn and debt show whether the business can fund itself.
segments.tr: - **Finanzberichte.** Umsatzwachstum, Gewinn oder Verlust, Cash-Burn und Schulden zeigen, ob sich das Geschäft selbst finanzieren kann.

segments.src: - **Risk factors.** Companies must describe material risks, including competition, regulation, customer concentration and dependence on key suppliers.
segments.tr: - **Risikofaktoren.** Unternehmen müssen wesentliche Risiken beschreiben, darunter Wettbewerb, Regulierung, Kundenkonzentration und Abhängigkeit von zentralen Lieferanten.

segments.src: - **Use of proceeds.** This explains whether the money will fund growth, repay debt or simply pass to selling shareholders.
segments.tr: - **Verwendung der Erlöse.** Dies erklärt, ob das Geld für Wachstum verwendet wird, Schulden tilgt oder schlicht an verkaufende Aktionäre fließt.

segments.src: - **Capital structure.** Some companies issue multiple share classes, where founders hold extra voting power. That affects how much say ordinary shareholders have.
segments.tr: - **Kapitalstruktur.** Manche Unternehmen geben mehrere Aktienklassen aus, wobei Gründer zusätzliche Stimmrechte halten. Das beeinflusst, wie viel Mitsprache normale Aktionäre haben.

segments.src: - **Lock-up agreements.** Insiders often agree not to sell for a set period, commonly around 180 days. When it ends, a large number of shares can become tradable at once, which can affect the price.
segments.tr: - **Haltefristvereinbarungen (Lock-up).** Insider verpflichten sich häufig, für einen festgelegten Zeitraum nicht zu verkaufen, meist etwa 180 Tage. Wenn dieser endet, kann eine große Zahl von Aktien auf einmal handelbar werden, was den Kurs beeinflussen kann.

segments.src: - **Valuation context.** The price range implies a total company value. Comparing it with revenue and earnings, and with similar listed companies, helps show how much growth is already expected.
segments.tr: - **Bewertungskontext.** Die Preisspanne impliziert einen Gesamtunternehmenswert. Der Vergleich mit Umsatz und Gewinn sowie mit ähnlichen börsennotierten Unternehmen hilft zu zeigen, wie viel Wachstum bereits erwartet wird.

segments.src: ## Does a Flood of New Shares Pull Money From Other Stocks?
segments.tr: ## Zieht eine Flut neuer Aktien Geld aus anderen Aktien ab?

segments.src: The worry is a supply-and-demand one.
segments.tr: Die Sorge ist eine Frage von Angebot und Nachfrage.

segments.src: If investors must buy billions of dollars of new shares, some may sell other holdings to pay for them.
segments.tr: Müssen Anleger Aktien im Wert von Milliarden Dollar neu kaufen, verkaufen manche möglicherweise andere Bestände, um diese zu bezahlen.

segments.src: In that case, a very large listing could weigh on existing stocks, particularly the ones most similar to the newcomer.
segments.tr: In diesem Fall könnte ein sehr großer Börsengang auf bestehenden Aktien lasten, besonders auf jenen, die dem Neuling am ähnlichsten sind.

segments.src: The reality is less clear-cut:
segments.tr: Die Realität ist weniger eindeutig:

segments.src: - **Markets are very large.** U.S. stocks trade in the tens of billions of dollars every day, and total market value is measured in the tens of trillions. Even a very large offering is a small slice of that.
segments.tr: - **Die Märkte sind sehr groß.** US-Aktien werden täglich für zig Milliarden Dollar gehandelt, und der Gesamtmarktwert wird in zig Billionen gemessen. Selbst ein sehr großes Angebot ist nur ein kleiner Ausschnitt davon.

segments.src: - **Funding sources vary.** Money for an IPO can come from cash on the sidelines, new fund inflows or the proceeds of earlier sales, not only from selling other stocks.
segments.tr: - **Finanzierungsquellen variieren.** Geld für einen Börsengang kann aus bereitliegendem Bargeld, neuen Mittelzuflüssen in Fonds oder den Erlösen früherer Verkäufe stammen, nicht nur aus dem Verkauf anderer Aktien.

segments.src: - **Sector effects are more plausible.** If the new company is in a crowded theme, such as AI, investors who want to own it may trim similar names. That effect is usually narrower than a market-wide drop.
segments.tr: - **Sektoreffekte sind plausibler.** Wenn das neue Unternehmen in einem überfüllten Thema tätig ist, etwa KI, könnten Anleger, die es besitzen wollen, ähnliche Werte reduzieren. Dieser Effekt ist meist enger begrenzt als ein marktweiter Rückgang.

segments.src: - **Sentiment matters.** A strong debut can lift enthusiasm for the whole sector. A weak one can chill it. History includes examples of both.
segments.tr: - **Die Stimmung spielt eine Rolle.** Ein starkes Debüt kann die Begeisterung für den gesamten Sektor anheben. Ein schwaches kann sie dämpfen. Die Geschichte kennt Beispiele für beides.

segments.src: In short, a big IPO can shift money around within a market.
segments.tr: Kurz gesagt: Ein großer Börsengang kann Geld innerhalb eines Marktes verschieben.

segments.src: Whether it drains the market as a whole is much less certain, and it is hard to predict.
segments.tr: Ob er den Markt insgesamt entzieht, ist deutlich ungewisser und schwer vorherzusagen.

segments.src: ## Why Index-Fund Holders May Still Be Exposed
segments.tr: ## Warum Indexfonds-Inhaber trotzdem exponiert sein können

segments.src: Many people assume that owning a broad index fund means they have no stake in IPOs.
segments.tr: Viele Menschen nehmen an, dass ein breiter Indexfonds bedeutet, dass sie keinen Anteil an Börsengängen haben.

segments.src: That is only partly true.
segments.tr: Das stimmt nur teilweise.

segments.src: - **Index inclusion rules differ.** Some major indexes require a new company to trade for a set period, or to meet profitability and size tests, before it can join. Others add new listings more quickly. Rules vary by index provider, so check the methodology for the specific index your fund tracks.
segments.tr: - **Aufnahmeregeln für Indizes unterscheiden sich.** Einige große Indizes verlangen, dass ein neues Unternehmen für einen festgelegten Zeitraum gehandelt wird oder Rentabilitäts- und Größenkriterien erfüllt, bevor es aufgenommen wird. Andere nehmen neue Notierungen schneller auf. Die Regeln variieren je nach Indexanbieter, daher sollte man die Methodik des konkreten Index prüfen, den der Fonds abbildet.

segments.src: - **Total-market funds add new listings.** Funds that follow broad "total market" indexes tend to take in newly listed large companies relatively soon after they list.
segments.tr: - **Gesamtmarktfonds nehmen neue Notierungen auf.** Fonds, die breite "Total-Market"-Indizes abbilden, nehmen neu notierte große Unternehmen relativ bald nach der Notierung auf.

segments.src: - **Market-cap weighting amplifies size.** In a market-capitalization-weighted index, a very large new company can quickly become a meaningful share of the fund. Existing holdings are then diluted slightly, and the fund buys the new stock, which can add to demand around inclusion.
segments.tr: - **Marktkapitalisierungsgewichtung verstärkt die Größe.** In einem marktkapitalisierungsgewichteten Index kann ein sehr großes neues Unternehmen schnell einen erheblichen Anteil am Fonds ausmachen. Bestehende Positionen werden dann leicht verwässert, und der Fonds kauft die neue Aktie, was die Nachfrage rund um die Aufnahme erhöhen kann.

segments.src: - **Float matters.** Many indexes weight companies by the shares actually available to the public, called the free float. A mega-listing that sells only a small percentage of its shares might start with a smaller index weight than its headline valuation suggests, and that weight can grow as insiders sell later.
segments.tr: - **Der Streubesitz ist wichtig.** Viele Indizes gewichten Unternehmen nach den tatsächlich öffentlich verfügbaren Aktien, dem sogenannten Free Float. Ein Mega-Börsengang, der nur einen kleinen Prozentsatz seiner Aktien verkauft, startet womöglich mit einem geringeren Indexgewicht, als es seine Schlagzeilen-Bewertung vermuten lässt, und dieses Gewicht kann wachsen, wenn Insider später verkaufen.

segments.src: - **Concentration risk.** If several very large technology-related companies join the same index, the fund can become more concentrated in one theme than its owner realizes.
segments.tr: - **Konzentrationsrisiko.** Wenn mehrere sehr große technologienahe Unternehmen demselben Index beitreten, kann der Fonds stärker auf ein Thema konzentriert sein, als sein Besitzer erkennt.

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Investors
segments.tr: ## Praktische Erkenntnisse für Anleger

segments.src: - **Do not treat a debut as a guarantee.** First-day gains are common in popular offerings but not universal, and later performance has often lagged for investors who bought at high opening prices.
segments.tr: - **Ein Debüt ist keine Garantie.** Kursgewinne am ersten Tag sind bei beliebten Angeboten häufig, aber nicht universell, und die spätere Entwicklung blieb für Käufer zu hoher Eröffnungskurse oft hinter den Erwartungen zurück.

segments.src: - **Read the prospectus.** The risk factors and capital structure sections are free and often more informative than news coverage.
segments.tr: - **Den Prospekt lesen.** Die Abschnitte zu Risikofaktoren und Kapitalstruktur sind kostenlos verfügbar und oft aussagekräftiger als Nachrichtenberichte.

segments.src: - **Check what you already own.** Look at your fund's top holdings and methodology to see how it treats new listings.
segments.tr: - **Prüfen, was man bereits besitzt.** Die größten Positionen des Fonds und seine Methodik zeigen, wie er mit neuen Notierungen umgeht.

segments.src: - **Watch for lock-up expirations.** Dates are disclosed in the filing and can be periods of added volatility.
segments.tr: - **Auf den Ablauf von Haltefristen achten.** Die Termine sind im Prospekt angegeben und können Phasen erhöhter Volatilität sein.

segments.src: - **Keep position sizes sensible.** Diversification across sectors and asset types remains the main protection against any single theme going wrong.
segments.tr: - **Positionsgrößen vernünftig wählen.** Diversifikation über Branchen und Anlageklassen bleibt der wichtigste Schutz davor, dass ein einzelnes Thema schiefgeht.

segments.src: - **Match investments to your time horizon.** Short-term price moves around big events are hard to predict, and long-term investors generally do not need to react to each headline.
segments.tr: - **Investments auf den eigenen Anlagehorizont abstimmen.** Kurzfristige Kursbewegungen rund um große Ereignisse sind schwer vorherzusagen, und langfristige Anleger müssen generell nicht auf jede Schlagzeile reagieren.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: A wave of mega-listings would mark a notable shift in market conditions, signaling that companies and their backers see public investors as ready to buy.
segments.tr: Eine Welle von Mega-Börsengängen würde eine bemerkenswerte Veränderung der Marktbedingungen markieren und signalisieren, dass Unternehmen und ihre Geldgeber die Öffentlichkeit als kaufbereit sehen.

segments.src: For investors, the sensible approach is to understand the mechanics, read the disclosures and notice how index funds may quietly add exposure.
segments.tr: Für Anleger ist der vernünftige Ansatz, die Mechanik zu verstehen, die Offenlegungen zu lesen und zu erkennen, wie Indexfonds unauffällig Engagement hinzufügen können.

segments.src: The effects on the wider market are uncertain, and no one can reliably time them.
segments.tr: Die Auswirkungen auf den breiteren Markt sind ungewiss, und niemand kann sie verlässlich timen.
